visual.description: Black screen (#1A1B22). '$82,933' fades in center-screen in Montserrat Bold 72px (#EAE0D5) with small USA text badge. Then '$69,433' appears below with DEU badge. Text animates: 'USA earns 19% more.' Beat. Then new line: 'But Germany earns 13% more per hour.' Germany number glows (#D8A7B1), USA dims. Calendar icon shows '470 hours = 59 workdays' crossed out.

notes: Opening hook — salary numbers appear, then re-sort by hourly rate shatters the assumption. Germany and Denmark rise, USA drops. No Big Mac reference. Use text country code badges (NOT emoji flags — Remotion can't render them). Stagger fade-ins 0.3s apart, spring-animated re-sort. Numbers glow #D8A7B1 as they move.
